stem:
Read the following sentence from paragraph 6.

One of these programs is managed by people in Africa who once received bags from Wignall!
instruction: The author includes this sentence most likely to —

options.label: A
options.text: illustrate how many Care Bags programs there are in the world

options.label: B
options.text: show that Wignall’s project has had a positive effect on others

options.label: C
options.text: demonstrate why more volunteers for Care Bags programs are needed

options.label: D
options.text: show how long it can take for Wignall’s bags to reach people in need

visual_elements: One of these programs is managed by people in Africa who once received bags from Wignall!
